scalars.scalar_value: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university; and
Experience working in a community college or other postsecondary educational environment

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic, and lived-experience backgrounds

items.item_text: For questions regarding this position, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@frc.edu .
Visa Sponsorship
H1B1 visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university; and

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic, and lived-experience backgrounds
One (1) year of experience in advising, outreach, education support, student services, youth development, recruitment, or related student-focused services;
Experience working in a community college or other postsecondary educational environment
Communicate effectively and respectfully with individuals from varied backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives
An equivalent combination of education and experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position.
Experience working with diverse student populations, including first-generation, low-income, historically underserved, disproportionately impacted, or nontraditional student populations
Experience conducting outreach, workshops, presentations, or student engagement activities
Experience supporting student success, retention, or educational support initiatives
Experience utilizing student information systems, databases, educational technologies, website content tools, or digital communication platforms

Provide advising support, guidance, and information to students regarding academic processes, institutional requirements, educational pathways, student support services, and available resources within established guidelines
Assist students with navigating admissions, registration, enrollment, financial aid, transfer, educational planning, and related student support processes

Support equitable access to programs, services, and resources for students from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic, and educational backgrounds
Provide culturally responsive communication and student support practices that promote student engagement, persistence, retention, and educational success
Assist students in identifying educational, career, transfer, and support service resources appropriate to individual needs and goals
Refer students to appropriate departments, faculty, counselors, support programs, community resources, and external agencies as needed
Coordinate and support student success activities, workshops, orientations, outreach events, campus visits, presentations, and engagement activities
Assist in outreach and engagement efforts designed to increase student participation, access, persistence, and success for historically underserved and disproportionately impacted student populations
Develop and maintain outreach, advising, workshop, presentation, and informational materials using print, presentation, website, and digital communication platforms
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with students to support participation, retention, academic progress, and educational engagement
Assist students in understanding institutional policies, procedures, deadlines, and program requirements
Maintain accurate electronic and physical records, documentation, case notes, participation records, and related program data
Compile, track, monitor, and prepare reports related to assigned activities, participation, student services, and operational requirements
Utilize student information systems, databases, spreadsheets, communication systems, and related technologies to support assigned activities and operational needs
Collaborate with faculty, staff, administrators, schools, community organizations, and external partners to support coordinated student services and student success initiatives
Foster welcoming, respectful, inclusive, and student-centered interactions with students, employees, and community members
Maintain confidentiality of student information and records in accordance with FERPA and applicable laws, regulations, and District policies
Participate in meetings, trainings, professional development activities, committees, and shared governance activities as assigned
May provide lead direction to student assistants, peer mentors, tutors, or temporary staff
May be assigned to special populations such as co-enrolled high school students, CalWORKS participants, students experiencing academic difficulties
Plan and deliver workshops and other student success activities and initiatives
Assist in the implementation of activities outlined in the Student Equity Plan
Collect and analyze data; write reports that evaluate the effectiveness of student success initiatives and activities
Perform related duties as assigned
Principles and practices of student support services, advising support, outreach, recruitment, and student success programs
Willingness to work occasional evenings, weekends, or off-site activities in support of assigned programs and student services
College processes and procedures related to admissions, registration, records, financial aid, transfer, student services, and educational support programs
Applicable policies, procedures, regulations, confidentiality requirements, and FERPA requirements related to student records and support services
Principles of culturally responsive communication, equitable student engagement, and inclusive student support practices
Student support strategies designed to promote access, persistence, retention, and educational success for diverse student populations
Outreach, workshop coordination, presentation, and student engagement practices
Recordkeeping, reporting, data tracking, and file maintenance practices
Standard office software, databases, student information systems, website content tools, social media communication tools, and digital communication platforms
Principles of effective communication, customer service, and interpersonal interaction
Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation, and business correspondence
Provide guidance, information, outreach, and student support services within established procedures and guidelines
Assist students with navigating educational, enrollment, transfer, and support service processes
Support inclusive and equitable student engagement and service delivery practices that promote student success
Coordinate workshops, outreach activities, presentations, orientations, and student support activities
Organize, prioritize, and manage multiple assignments, activities, deadlines, and operational processes with attention to detail
Interpret and explain policies, procedures, deadlines, eligibility requirements, and program guidelines
Maintain accurate records, documentation, reports, and program data
Utilize databases, spreadsheets, student information systems, and related technologies effectively
Develop and maintain informational, outreach, and presentation materials
Exercise sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality in handling sensitive information
Adapt to changing priorities, operational needs, technologies, regulations, and student service requirements
Work independently within established guidelines and collaboratively as part of a team
Ability to travel locally and regionally as required by the assignment
Demonstrated ability to support inclusive and equitable student engagement and success initiatives
Demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students
